item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: Travis Head recalls Australia’s 2023 ODI World Cup comeback ‘blueprint’ after shocking loss to Zimbabwe
item.description: Zimbabwe pulled off a major upset in Group B of the ICC Men's T20 World Cup, defeating Australia by 23 runs at the R. Premadasa Stadium on Friday. After posting 169/2 on the board, Zimbabwe bundled out the Aussies for 146 in 19.3 overs to win the contest by 23 runs. Despite the shocking loss, stand-in Australia captain Travis Head called for calm, highlighting their turnaround during the triumphant 2023 ODI World Cup campaign after a shaky start. item.description: India recorded their biggest ever T20 World Cup victory by a margin of 93 runs against Namibia on Thursday (February 12) at the Arun Jaitley Stadium in Delhi. Opener Ishan Kishan (61 off 24) and all-rounder Hardik Pandya (52 off 28) produced aggressive half-centuries, propelling the hosts to a formidable total of 209/9 after being put in to bat first. item.description: MS Dhoni’s achievement as a cricketer is surreal, to say the least. He has etched his name in the cricketing folklore as one of the finest captains ever.
